name: Seated Marching

instructions.description: Sit upright near the front of a stable chair with both feet flat on the floor, about hip-width apart. Keep your chest open, shoulders relaxed, and core gently engaged. Let your arms rest naturally by your sides or cross them comfortably over your chest.
Lift one knee toward your chest in a slow and controlled movement while keeping your upper body upright. Keep your core engaged to prevent your lower back from arching excessively.
Lower your foot gently back to the floor, then lift the opposite knee. Continue alternating sides while maintaining a stable seated position and keeping your pelvis neutral.
Keep a smooth, controlled rhythm and breathe naturally throughout the exercise. Stay focused on maintaining good core tension and avoid compensating by leaning backward or arching your lower back.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the time performed with comfortable, controlled technique.
Record average movement or step cadence.
Record the individual's perceived effort after the exercise.

variations.variationDescription: Seated Marching — Interval Progression: Alternate manageable work and recovery periods while keeping the same activity.

commentsNotes: Use a stable chair without wheels.
Keep your chest upright and shoulders relaxed without leaning backward.
Lift each knee only as high as you can without losing your posture or core control.
